'''Bellum''' was a [[Forger (profession)|forger]], also known as '''Bellum the Forger''', who lived on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] acting under the influence of [[X0-X1]].
